title: libcuflynx supermodule parameters (<module_type>_<module_subtype>_parameters.json)
description: The parameter values of a supermodule version's instances, beside its module array (<module_type>_<module_subtype>_module_array.json) and config. It names every instance of the array once. A model is generated from these values: an instance's parameter <var> becomes {var}_<record>__<instance>. The supermodule's parameterisation (the host record's, or its default_parameterisation) is read over them, and the host parameters file over that; a parameter the file does not give comes from the instance's version's default parameterisation. cuflynx-upgrade module-config writes it when it converts a supermodule; after that it is the file that is edited and calibrated. Read by libcuflynx/utilities/config_schemas.py (load_supermodule_parameters).

instances.description: Required. {instance name: its parameters}, one entry for each record of the supermodule's module array.

parameterisation.description: Required. The parameterisation of the instance's version its values started from: "default" (the version's default_parameterisation) or the name of another of its parameterisations. A record of where the values came from; generation reads the values in "parameters".

parameters.description: Required. {variable: value}. A component instance's are its own variables ("E_A"); a supermodule instance's are paths into it ("i_M/g_M"), which override its own parameters file. Globals are set by the supermodule's parameterisation, not here.

value.description: Required. The value, as a parameters CSV's value column holds it.

units.description: Required. Its units, as in a parameters CSV.

data_reference.description: Where the value comes from, as in a parameters CSV. Default: empty.

parameter.description: One parameter: a parameters CSV row's columns. Other string keys (a module library's "sourced") are kept and not read.
